aboutText: With over 25 years of combined experience serving Footscray and Melbourne's western suburbs, Boxshall Group delivers expert electrical, hydraulic and mechanical services to commercial and industrial clients. Our licensed team is committed to sustainable, innovative solutions that meet the highest standards. From scoping and consulting through to installation and ongoing maintenance, we manage every project with precision. As a locally owned and operated business on Crown Street, we take pride in building lasting relationships with every client we serve.
fullWidthImageAlt: Boxshall Group industrial project in Footscray
servicesText: At Boxshall Group, we provide a comprehensive range of electrical, hydraulic and mechanical services to commercial and industrial clients across Melbourne. Our integrated approach means we can manage your entire project from initial scoping through to design, installation and ongoing maintenance.

services.title: Consulting & Design
services.desc: Our consultants provide expert scoping, planning and engineering for complex multi-trade electrical, hydraulic and mechanical projects.

services.title: Design & Construct
services.desc: We deliver full design and construct solutions, managing your project from initial concept through to final commissioning.

services.title: Electrical & Lighting
services.desc: Complete electrical services including switchboard upgrades, power distribution, data cabling and energy-efficient Lumenall lighting.

services.title: Hydraulic Services
services.desc: Full hydraulic services covering backflow prevention, drainage, hot water systems, gas fitting and compliance testing for commercial buildings.

services.title: Mechanical Services
services.desc: Expert mechanical installation and repair covering HVAC systems, ventilation, industrial equipment and commercial plant maintenance.

services.title: Service & Maintenance
services.desc: Proactive preventive maintenance programs and rapid emergency response to keep your critical systems operating at peak performance.

bannerSubheading: Our experienced team delivers reliable electrical, hydraulic and mechanical services across Melbourne.

testimonials.text: Boxshall Group completely rewired our factory in Footscray and installed new energy-efficient lighting throughout. The project was finished on schedule and the quality of work was outstanding. Our energy bills have dropped significantly since the upgrade.
testimonials.name: Dave Morrison

testimonials.text: We engaged Boxshall for a full hydraulic system audit and upgrade at our commercial complex. Their engineering team identified issues we had no idea about and delivered a compliant solution under budget. Highly professional service.
testimonials.name: Sarah Chen

testimonials.text: The team handles all our mechanical and electrical maintenance across three venues. They are always responsive, honest and thorough. Finding a reliable tradie who actually shows up when they say they will has been a game changer.
testimonials.name: Tom Bradley
